reviews.author: Dionne M
reviews.text: I can't recommend Ted at Archer Automotive highly enough! It's so refreshing to find a mechanic who is honest, knowledgeable, and truly puts the customer first. I originally brought my 2014 Hyundai Elantra in because I was hearing a knocking noise from the engine and was also having A/C issues. Ted took the time to inspect everything thoroughly and explained his findings in a way that was easy to understand. Instead of trying to sell me expensive repairs, he recommended that I contact Hyundai first to see if my engine might qualify for a warranty extension or recall before spending any money. That level of honesty is rare. He also inspected my brakes after another shop quoted me nearly $500 for pads and rotors. After checking them himself, he told me my brakes were in good shape and that I didn't need the repair. He could have easily taken my money, but he chose to do the right thing instead. For my A/C, he diagnosed a slow refrigerant leak, added UV dye so the source could be identified later if needed, recharged the system, and explained exactly what to watch for. I left with cold air and a clear plan instead of being pressured into replacing parts that might not be necessary. Ted is professional, patient, fair, and incredibly trustworthy. It's hard to find a mechanic who values honesty over making a quick sale, and that's exactly what I found at Archer Automotive. They've earned my trust and my future business, and I'll be recommending them to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Alena Yarmolyuk
reviews.text: Literally the worst. A customer in front of me was trying to understand what the problem was with his vehicle and was voicing his worries and opinion and the owner kept talking down to the customer. Was disrespectful. Didn’t resolve the issue nor was insightful, understanding or helpful. Absolutely disgusting customer service with zero help. Also doesn’t take credit cards but only cash because he knows ppl will dispute most of the transactions because he has no idea what the hell he’s doing.

reviews.author: Samantha Bowen
reviews.text: Our family has been using Archer for years and Ted and his crew are some of the most knowledgeable, fair and hard working guys out there.

reviews.author: Ryan Bowen
reviews.text: Ted did a great job on my Land Cruiser. He was the only mechanic anywhere near who was even willing to look at the issue I had, and he had the experience to fix the mistakes of someone else in a few days. I had great communication, fair pricing and awesome service.

reviews.author: Sarah Pinti
reviews.text: I drive all the way from Fort Mill, South Carolina to get to get my car serviced here. I’m thankful for their fair prices and their honesty.

reviews.author: E Singh
reviews.text: Ted is the best around! I don’t trust another mechanic with my 3 vehicles. Ted is professional and I respect and appreciate his quote estimates, advice and reliability. He gets us in and out quickly and hires knowledgeable staff. So good to have quality service close to home.

reviews.author: Mike Young
reviews.text: I took my 2008 GMC Yukon to Archer Automotive on the suggestion from a co-worker and couldn't be happier with the service, communication, pricing, etc. Ted was terrific to work with from the get-go. He's straight-forward, honest, and tells it like it is. That may be a bit abrupt for some, but I appreciate it rather than some of these other dishonest, long-winded shops. Ted did a full electronics charging system diagnosis and replaced my failing alternator all at a fair price (better than 2 or 3 other local shops I checked) and with good timing (same day). I've found my new trusted mechanic for my vehicles and not even 10 minutes from home!

reviews.author: Kir Kel
reviews.text: Call the number from the photo for Archer Automotive not the phone number Google has (old number). This is our go to place for both our cars. I was brought up with a lot of car talk with car sales in the family and this isn’t bells and whistles with sales attached this is fixing your car and fixing it well with a reliable mechanic. We have given up on shopping around for quotes - there is no point (unless you want the feel good moment of relief after wasting your time and suffering the stress). Ask for Ted - he’s your guy :)

reviews.author: carl joseph deMarco
reviews.text: Excellent place to get your vehicle worked on. No nonsense, quality work, and a reasonable price. I've been in twice now with my '95 Ranger and been completely satisfied. The truck always seems better than it was before the repair was needed, not just fixed. Highly recommend this shop for auto repair.

reviews.author: Kelly Johnson
reviews.text: We just recently had a problem with our Ford. The guys here treated us so well. They were quick and had our car fixed within a day. Excellent customer service and fair pricing. We would highly recommend them and will bring our vehicles to them again.

reviews.author: Keith Dittl
reviews.text: I've been looking for a reliable mechanic and think that I've found one. My experience with Ted and Archer Automotive was good from the start. I stopped by on a Friday to ask if they could look at my truck and they worked it in the following Monday morning. They were prompt and honest in their assessment, fixing my issue quickly, cost effectively and getting my truck back to me a day later. I appreciate the personal experience that you get with a small shop versus a dealership and will definitely be bringing my vehicles here if needed in the future.

reviews.author: Al Glaza
reviews.text: Great place for all your automotive needs. I have used them several times and have been extremely happy with their service. Ted explains everything to you and will give you an estimate before he does any repairs. I highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Callea Romanyshyn
reviews.text: I love a place where you can see and talk to the owner every time! Ted has great pricing and he is honest. About two years ago, I went to some terrible auto repair in Charlotte and they had a whole list of repairs I had to do as well as a pricy tie-rod end replacement. The estimate for everything was almost 2k! I took the estimate to receive a second option from Ted (the owner at Archer Automotive) who said the tie-rod end looks perfectly fine and instead suggested I did a repair at a fraction of the cost, more around the $200 range! I have heard of many auto repair places that take advantage of people and practically make up needed replacements but I am happy that I found someone I can trust. Ted, thank you for your honesty and I will continue to be a loyal customer.

reviews.author: Stephanie Balasco
reviews.text: These guys are the real deal!! They do great work, stand by their work and are very reasonably priced. I had been over paying on vehicle repairs for YEARS and not even getting a good job done. These guys corrected other mechanics mistakes on my car!! They really want to do good work and they really do a great job!!! Can't sing these guys praises enough!

reviews.author: Martin Anthony
reviews.text: I patronized Archer Automotive for the first time in April 2023, based on a strong recommendation posted on our community Facebook page. I was given a fair price for my repairs and solid advice to keep my '14 Camry running for a long time. I will never patronize a dealership again! They are heavily overpriced! And very dishonest!!!

reviews.author: Theresa Vozza Nicolosi
reviews.text: They know cars and are real honest and care about their customers. My son took his Subaru in and they took great care of him and helped advise him on auto needs and helped make his ride safer. Thank you !!!

reviews.author: Derek Smith
reviews.text: Horrible, rude, unprofessional and dishonest. Was told we'd have a quote the next morning. 2 days later and he's threatening not to look at the car, simply because we called for an update. Ultimately had it towed to another shop but only after he charged us DOUBLE his stated and advertised (on the wall of his shop) price for diagnostics. This crook deserves to go out of business.

reviews.author: Jonathan Halbreich
reviews.text: I brought the car in for a full synthetic oil changed and also asked the gentleman to check my rear brakes. The rear brakes were not checked or no report was given. The main issue is that the drain plug was not secured properly and I leaked engine oil from South Carolina all the way to Florida. Whoever worked on my vehicle put myself and of course the vehicle at risk. The block could have been fried killing the car. Other reviews may say good things but I'll never bring my car there ever again or suggest that someone use their services.

reviews.author: Wade Feaster
reviews.text: I have used Archer automotive several times for different problems on my 2006 Subaru outback. We've had very good luck with Ted. Everything has been done right and well. We had a repair on a power steering pump and the power steering pump went bad he replaced it without any issues at all. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Adam Schwantner
reviews.text: 2007 Ford Expedition owner. Archer Automotive came to the rescue! Tom and Joe were extremely helpful and professional. They offer Great communication, excellent customer service and honest pricing. They really care about their customers. They have earned my repeat business going forward.

reviews.author: David Walker
reviews.text: Just picked up my 2011 Ford Ranger pickup from Archer on 4-3-20. This was my second visit, and once again they got me back up and running in no time. They diagnosed the immediate problem, repaired it, and I had some preventative maintenance done while I had it in the. As long as I live around here I'd never take my vehicle anywhere else and I was stunned at how reasonable the final bill was. - David Walker, Clover, SC

reviews.author: Perry Stacks
reviews.text: The control arm replacements were fine… it just would have been really nice to have known that it didn’t include an alignment & that would be another trip to a different garage. Just be absolutely sure what it is you’re getting.

reviews.author: Charles P
reviews.text: Ted and the crew are great! They were able to look at my car on a days notice as well as fix. You can tell they care about their customers.... I would recommend them for any car repairs!

reviews.author: David Frintner
reviews.text: I rarely write reviews, but they have been outstanding and have helped me maintain my car better than anyone. The prices are reasonable and they explain what they are doing before any repair.

reviews.author: Nicol Prophet
reviews.text: Professional & honest. What was most important to me was communication. Archer Automotive never left me wondering. Upfront about costs and did a great job on my 2005 Saturn Vue.

reviews.author: SSP
reviews.text: Great local mechanic! Great work for a very fair price. Nice people that work there. They took the time to answer a lot questions I had. It's definitely my new mechanic shop.

reviews.author: Richard Webb
reviews.text: Ted is a professional...he is an expert at becoming an expert on any type of automobile problem. He is honest, conscientious and approachable. This shop is the ONLY place I will take my cars, otherwise, I do the work myself.

reviews.author: Mary M
reviews.text: This is a great place for automotive repairs. I just took my truck there and Ted had it fixed right up for me. Friendly and fair pricing, I have found my new mechanics.

reviews.author: Kelly Brown
reviews.text: Extremely unprofessional! I was told to bring my car at 8 a.m. and sat for 30 minutes waiting for the mechanic to arrive. He never did. I called the phone number 3 times and no one answered. The voicemail box was full and I was unable to leave a voicemail. I will not be recommending to anyone. Very unprofessional and rude.

reviews.author: Kris Siuta
reviews.text: I have been going to this garage for 2 years now. And every time they are professional technicians. They don't gouge you on pricing. And they do top-notch work. Highly highly recommended.

reviews.text: I have had work done on two vehicles and have been very pleased thus far. I have been pleased not only for the quality of work but these guys actually take time to talk to you and allow you the opportunity to ask questions and respond in a way that you understand.

reviews.author: josh beamon
